v1.feedback: The deep-ecology → naïveté chain is legible: stromatolite mounds soften into lollipop-tree canopies, and the childlike Rousseau reference lands. But the ring-of-mounds and ring-of-trees layouts both read as symmetric halos from the default camera at z=34 — the form lacks a focal anchor and risks looking like a radial scatter rather than a jungle or reef. Pull the camera closer (z~22) or bias tree placement toward center-mass so the silhouette reads in <2s. The extinction float-up is poetic but the ascending ghosts just dissolve into empty black — give them a faint horizontal drift or spiral so they feel 'wondered at' rather than deleted. Palette is restrained and earned; the CO₂ breathing is a nice touch but at 0.15 scale it's nearly invisible — consider doubling it so the form's expansion across epochs is actually perceivable.

v2.feedback: The deep-time concept is rich but this reads as a fresh build, not a morph from the dark-ecology parent — the brief explicitly says 'NOT a fresh start,' yet no parent geometry or shader DNA survives here. Stromatolite mounds and lollipop canopies are both spherical blobs with surface bias; give at least one pose a non-radial silhouette (branching L-system trunks, or columnar stromatolites with laminar stacking) so the morph travels through genuinely different topology. The extinction-ghost spiral is the strongest visual moment — lean into it by varying ghost drift direction per speciesGroup instead of a uniform upward spiral, so mass-death reads as diaspora rather than ascending confetti.
